Status: Wave 310 accepted (6.3): the SerialNumber and IndividualAddress getters

Method.evidence: Five free no-argument accessors found with returning-free.py: four return Knx.Falcon.SerialNumber (Class814::b(), Class837::a(), Class898::a(), Class899::a()) and one returns Knx.Falcon.IndividualAddress (Class801::b()). The family names these shapes get_/set_SerialNumber (Class838, Class900) and get_/set_IndividualAddress (Class900), each row sits in a distinct class and no class holds a second accessor of the same type, so no name collided.
Method.themes: Third wave from the returning-free.py family read. It also showed the shapes it cannot use: Class801::a() returns IEnumerable<IndividualAddress> and Class801::a(int) takes an index, both different members, and the Task<SerialNumber>/Task<IndividualAddress> helpers (Class601, Class604) are async steps rather than accessors. Remaining blockers unchanged: Interface20/21/25/26, Class938 d(ulong), the two dispatchers, Class871 s four packed fields, the Class319-returning accessors, and the call-chain-only blocks.
